title: Coin Change
description: Given coin denominations and an amount, compute the minimum number of coins required to make the amount, or return -1 if impossible. This is commonly solved with dynamic programming (bottom-up) using an array where dp[a] stores the fewest coins for amount a.

title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
description: Return the k-th largest element in an unsorted array. Approaches include using a min-heap of size k, quickselect (average O(n)), or sorting the array (O(n log n)). Choose based on performance trade-offs.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description: Find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence in an array. Solutions range from O(n^2) dynamic programming to an O(n log n) method using patience sorting / binary search over tails.
